**CPO has the highest Arena-Hard win rate in the Mistral-Instruct (7B) setting, at 22.6%** (Table 4, page 6).

The next highest are SimPO at 21.0% and ORPO at 20.8% (Table 4, page 6). Table 10 reports the same CPO figure with a 95% confidence interval of 20.8–25.0 (page 25).

The authors acknowledge this exception. They say SimPO is "occasionally surpassed by CPO" on Arena-Hard, and that CPO's responses are on average 50% longer than SimPO's. They suggest Arena-Hard "might favor longer generations due to the absence of a length penalty in its evaluation" (page 7). In this setting, CPO's average Arena-Hard response length is 812, compared with 539 for SimPO (Table 10, page 25).
